name: Marais Viljoen
role: President of South Africa from 1979 to 1984
contribution: A South African politician who served as the last ceremonial State President of South Africa from 4 June 1979 until 3 September 1984.

checks.lead: Marais Viljoen,  (2 December 1915 – 4 January 2007) was a South African politician who served as the last ceremonial State President of South Africa from 4 June 1979 until 3 September 1984. Viljoen became the last of the ceremonial presidents of South Africa when he was succeeded in 1984 by Prime Minister P. W. Botha, who combined the offices into an executive state presidency.
